_about: The world: regions, roads, where the player starts, shrines, named locations (for quests and the map), and where npcs, enemies and loot are placed. Positions are [x, z] in metres; north is -z. Positions are world positions (see world_map.json; Act 1 sits at its act1Offset). `regions`: Brackenford (`town`: [x, z, radius]), then Act 1's regions and the world's zones, each {id, name, levels}; which one you are in comes from the map, not the record. `roads` are drawn streets only (the world's roads come from world_map.json). A pond with `carved` is a lake baked into the ground, with `rx`/`rz` for an oval. `water`: ponds you can fish (a loot table of fish). `obscured`: areas too dark to enter without a torch. `chests`: chests to open, with `items`, `coins` (silver: a number, or a range {min, max} rolled when opened) and an optional `lock` ({key: item id, pick: Lockpicking rank}). placedLoot with `respawn` (seconds) is a gathering node: it grows back after it is taken; `scale` resizes its model; `quest` makes it takeable (and sparkle) only while that quest is active and still needs the item. `gates`: a gateway on a `line` that blocks until any of its `opensWhen` conditions holds (`shut`: never opens); `ring` is the stage of the opening it closes. `townWalls`: palisades along `lines`. `houses`: kit-built buildings you cannot enter (`roof`: thatch, slate or tile; `walls`: plaster, timber or stone).

gates.name: Brackenford's north gate
gates.closedText: The north gate is barred. The gate warden won't let a stranger wander off with the smith's business unsettled: take the cart's manifest to Mara Venn.
gates.openText: The gate wardens unbar Brackenford's gates. Bracken Vale is open to you.

gates.name: Brackenford's south gate
gates.closedText: The south gate to the ford is barred. Settle the smith's business first: take the cart's manifest to Mara Venn.

gates.name: The wardens' barricade
gates.closedText: A wardens' barricade blocks the Neck. "The Blackwood eats green lads. Come back when you've a few scars." (Opens at level 5.)
gates.openText: The wardens drag their barricade off the Neck. The world beyond the vale is open to you.

gates.name: The felled oak
gates.closedText: The oak the ambushers felled across the lane. It would take a team of oxen to shift it.
